The first draft initiated by: eng. Saleh Abdou, 
tested by eng Mohamed Abaas, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El 
Nagar, accepted by general manager eng Tarek Yosife Ali and approved 
by eng Mechaeal Gorge Habashy head sector of Ayoun Moussa power station .

The SR469 Motor Management Relay is a microprocessor based relay 
designed for the protection and management of medium and large horsepower motors 
and driven equipment. The SR469 is equipped with 6 output relays for trips, 
alarms, and start blocks. Motor protection, fault diagnostics, power metering, 
and RTU functions are integrated into one economical draw out package.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Motor out of service.

Make sure CT Secondary circuits are 
 shorted.

Ensure all CT path elements are secure after any 
 test disturbance.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings.

Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the 
 relay testing.

Check the 
 wires of the relay by hand.

Check the 
 AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect one 
 of them to the timer of the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.

sections.text: Test Steps

Connect the current leads of a tester unit to the relay 
 points according to the drawings and scheme.

Inject current to each couple of points till the red 
 flag of the device displays.

Repeat the steps for each pair of points according to 
 the test sheet.
Record the results.
